scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @relay/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @relay/server" "npm run dev --workspace @relay/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @relay/shared && npm run build --workspace @relay/server && npm run build --workspace @relay/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @relay/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @relay/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @relay/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @relay/shared && npm run test --workspace @relay/server
